description: Two retained ground terms have equal values in the specified finite structure if and only if their pair belongs to the computed bounded closure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.model_equality_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S)
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.SubtermClosed S)
  (t s : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L) (ht : t ∈ S) (hs : s ∈ S) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim t = FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim s ↔
    (t, s) ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure S E
